recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce the retired primaryDiagnosis extension or Encounter.diagnosis.rank for this seed; if non-billing diagnosis ordering is desired in the future, it should be handled as a new work-group decision against the current Encounter/Account model.
issue_request: FHIR-7613 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Patient Administration change request asking how Encounter diagnoses support primary/secondary ordering and facility versus professional billing distinctions. The accepted resolution kept reason and indication as separate multi-cardinality properties after a technical correction, used a positiveInt primaryDiagnosis extension for diagnosis sequence, and asked for implementer feedback on whether more detail was needed.
initial_application: Git commit 0983925cea4a4bac6ef715d2060f15156f6916d7 explicitly listed tracker 7613 and applied the original model by adding the encounter-primaryDiagnosis extension and Encounter reason/indication comments that described sequence with 1 as primary. Subsequent source history replaced that DSTU1 extension-based shape first with Encounter.diagnosis role/rank and then with the current Encounter.reason, Encounter.diagnosis, and Account.diagnosis model.
additional_context: Later final decisions intentionally supersede the original representation. FHIR-25215 removed stale references to the deleted primaryDiagnosis extension. FHIR-16148 redesigned Encounter.reason and Encounter.diagnosis to distinguish expected reasons from medical conditions addressed during the encounter. FHIR-19285 moved ranked billing diagnoses and procedures from Encounter to Account, and existing combined-branch reconciliations for FHIR-19285 and FHIR-38807 already closed remaining wording gaps in this area. Community evidence from Zulip and PA Confluence aligns with that history.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current active source has Encounter.reason and Encounter.diagnosis definitions, Encounter.diagnosis.use for diagnosis use, Account.diagnosis.sequence for numeric billing rank, and Condition narrative that tells implementers to use Account.diagnosis.sequence for primary/secondary/tertiary billing diagnosis ranking. No active core or extension-pack source still defines the retired primaryDiagnosis extension.
